openclawConfigPath.description: Path to openclaw.json for adding the explicit-ownership root include (default: ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json)

explicitConfigPath.description: Path to write the 11.3+ explicit-ownership include file (default: ~/.openclaw/agents-explicit.json)

heartbeatConfigMode.description: Heartbeat config emission mode. 'auto' detects from the host OpenClaw version (default). 'legacy' (<2026.11.5) emits per-agent heartbeat and agents.defaults.heartbeat. 'retired' (>=2026.11.5) emits neither, because the strict agent schema rejects the heartbeat key.
